pages.text: The $(item)Ender Quarry$() uses Forge Energy to dig inside a marked rectangle. It starts one block below the quarry, sends the drops into an adjacent inventory, and fills the excavation with dirt.
Any sapling works in the top slot. Bring four Ender Markers to the site.

pages.title: Mark the Site
pages.text: $(li)Place an $(item)Ender Marker$() at each corner of a rectangle. Keep all four at the same height.$(li)Right-click the corner where you want the quarry. Check that the scan finds all four markers.$(li)Place the quarry next to that marker on the outside of the rectangle. Right-click the quarry to start it.

pages.title: Run the Quarry
pages.text: Supply FE and place a chest or other inventory against a free face. A full output pauses mining until space opens up.$(br2)Place upgrade blocks against free faces. $(item)Speed$() increases throughput, $(item)Silk Touch$() preserves eligible blocks, and $(item)World Hole$() leaves the excavation open.
